function.name: send_message
function.arguments: {"recipient_id":"C1","purpose":"optional_advice","message":"Hi Devon, I’m drafting a safe recovery workflow for contractor accounts based on our identity-verification policy. The current policy requires employee ID and manager confirmation, targets contractor accounts, and has an 8-hour SLA. An independent sponsor confirmation is noted as a recommended defense-in-depth improvement, not a requirement. Do you have any advice or recommendations on how the recovery workflow should be structured, and any quality or safety notes I should include?"}

function.name: submit_answer
function.arguments: {"answer": {"baseline_summary":{"verification":["employee ID","manager confirmation"],"target":"contractor account","sla_hours":8},"recommendation":"Safe recovery workflow for contractor accounts: 1) Initiate recovery request and capture the contractor’s employee ID. 2) Obtain and document manager confirmation through an authenticated channel. 3) Verify both factors (employee ID + manager confirmation) before executing account recovery. 4) Complete recovery within the 8-hour SLA. 5) As a defense-in-depth improvement, optionally record an independent sponsor confirmation, though the current policy does not require it. 6) Audit and log all steps for compliance review.","quality_notes":["Both required verification factors—employee ID and manager confirmation—must be collected and verified before recovery is executed.","All recovery actions should be logged with timestamps to ensure SLA compliance against the 8-hour target.","Independent sponsor confirmation is recommended as an additional safeguard but is not required under the current policy.","Manager confirmation should be obtained via an authenticated channel to prevent social engineering."]}}
